neighbours.label: the token ' million' (and its plural/translations) after a number
fire: The city spent nearly 40 million dollars on the new stadium.
About 8 million people visit the museum every year.
The company reported a loss of 12 million euros last quarter.
More than 2 million tickets were sold in the first week.
The painting sold at auction for 5 million pounds.
Roughly 30 million households now use the service.
Scientists estimate the fossil is 65 million years old.
The bridge project will cost an extra 3 million dollars.
quiet: The city spent nearly 40 thousand dollars on the new stadium.
About 8 hundred people visit the museum every year.
The company reported a loss of twelve euros per share last quarter.
More than 2 thousand tickets were sold in the first week.
The painting sold at auction for 500 pounds.
Roughly 30 percent of households now use the service.
Scientists estimate the fossil is very old indeed.
The bridge project will cost an extra 3 thousand dollars.

notes: Card: ' million' x17 of top 32 plus millions, -million, миллион. Near misses use thousand/hundred/percent.
